User.title: User
User.description: Authenticated user profile in the application.

uid.description: Unique identifier for the user from Firebase Auth.

email.description: Primary email address of the user.

Interaction.title: Interaction
Interaction.description: A private journaling reflection and AI response with optional emotional mood tag.

userId.description: User UID who owns this interaction.

geminiResponse.description: AI reflection, brainstorm, or summary output.

mode.description: The processing mode selected by the user.

modelUsed.description: The Gemini model used to generate the reflection.

createdAt.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the interaction occurred.

title.description: Brief title summarizing the journal entry.

mood.description: Selected emotional state (emoji, label, and valence) at time of journaling.

/users/{userId}/interactions/{interactio.description: Subcollection containing all private journal reflections and emotional mood trends isolated to the owner.
